//: Sample Claude Code hook wiring for concord. Put concord-hook on PATH and run the concord daemon. There is deliberately no FileChanged hook (see docs/spikes/filechanged.md); shell writes are reconciled by the Bash|PowerShell PreToolUse snapshot + PostToolUse content-delta sweep (ADR-0008).

PreToolUse.//: Snapshots the dirty tree before a shell command so the PostToolUse sweep reconciles only what the command itself wrote (ADR-0008). Required for correct US3 protection.
